provider_model_version: catalog alias; immutable service snapshot unknown
primary_contrast: 100 * (test_gap_fb_protected - test_gap_fb_unprotected), percentage points; negative favors protection
output_fix: P1 showed planner truncation under 1800 output tokens. This batch preregisters 4000 planner and 2400 coder output caps; all other controller and evaluator rules stay fixed.
failure_policy: Each request is dispatched once. Parse failures consume the proposal slot. Indeterminate/provider failures stop that job and preserve missingness; no replacement or automatic retry. Test is opened only after every job is terminal or an explicit halt is recorded.
claims: Single-model output-repaired mechanism exposure screening on TSP14. It can test whether the protection mechanism is exercised after output completeness improves; it cannot establish cross-model, cross-task, or universal superiority.
progression_gate: Only if at least 6 of 8 pairs realize a protected development slot and at least 3 pairs expose a multi-branch slot may a later scheduling comparison be designed. Otherwise retain the exposure failure and stop causal expansion.
